plan.title: Create Single-Stage RFP from Asset PR

steps.note: Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation and prevent publish from being disabled by this setting.
Check that the RFP questionnaire screen does not show a pricing column.
Verify that the PR quantity is shown on the event screen.
Verify that the PR unit is shown on the event screen.
Provide the mandatory event title before publishing.
Add the two vendors named by the case.
Commit the 30-minute schedule with the event starting now.
Publish the completed single-stage RFP and confirm the publish dialog.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Verify that at least one requisition is present in the In Progress tab; the catalog cannot identify the exact selected PR row or event number here.
Return to the event created by this plan for its post-publish action checks.
Verify that Recreate Order is greyed out for an event created from a PR.
